audio-jack-buffer.brief: An audio breakout: four 3.5 mm jacks along the edge into an op-amp unity-gain buffer, no microcontroller.

buck-3a.brief: A 5 V to 3.3 V 3 A buck converter board (TPS5430) with input/output screw terminals and a thermal-via copper pour.

can-node.brief: A CAN bus node: an STM32 MCU, an SN65HVD230 transceiver, a DB9 connector, and a switchable bus terminator.

daq-8ch.brief: An eight-channel data-acquisition board: an MCU reading two ADS1115 ADCs over I2C, inputs on screw terminals, USB-C.

dual-rail-supply.brief: A plus/minus 12 V dual-rail supply from a 24 V input using a DC-DC converter, output on screw terminals.

encoder-oled-panel.brief: A front-panel board: a through-hole rotary encoder with push button, an SMT I2C OLED, three buttons, and four mounting holes.

esp32-dual-motor.brief: An ESP32-S3 robot controller with two DRV8833 motor drivers, a buck regulator from a 2S battery, and motor screw terminals.

esp32-s3-sensor.brief: An ESP32-S3 environmental sensor node: BME280 temp/humidity/pressure, USB-C, and a status LED.

fpc-breakout.brief: A 24-pin 0.5 mm-pitch FPC/FFC connector breakout to a 0.1-inch header row.

gpio-expander.brief: An I2C GPIO expander board: an MCP23017 with all sixteen lines on screw terminals and a chainable I2C header.

highside-switch-10a.brief: A high-side load switch: a logic-controlled P-channel MOSFET driving a 10 A load on screw terminals, with a thermal pad.

led-cc-driver.brief: A 1 A constant-current driver for a single power LED, USB-C input, with a heatsink copper area, no microcontroller.

lora-node.brief: A LoRa node: an SX1276 module with an SMA antenna connector, an STM32L0 MCU, and a screw-terminal sensor input.

nrf52-beacon.brief: An nRF52840 BLE beacon with an onboard chip antenna, a coin-cell holder, and a single user button.

proto-shield.brief: An Arduino-Uno-format prototyping shield with stacking through-hole headers and an onboard SMT 3.3 V regulator.

r2r-dac.brief: An R-2R resistor-ladder DAC breakout: eight logic inputs on a header into an op-amp buffered analog output, no microcontroller.

rc-lowpass-bnc.brief: A passive RC low-pass filter breakout with two BNC connectors and a cutoff-setting trim pot, no microcontroller.

relay-quad.brief: A four-channel relay board: through-hole relays driven by an SMT ULN2003, opto-isolated inputs, and screw-terminal outputs.

rp2040-min.brief: A minimal RP2040 board (QFN-56) with QSPI flash, USB-C, a 12 MHz crystal, and castellated GPIO.

rs485-terminal.brief: An isolated RS-485 transceiver board (MAX485) with screw-terminal A/B/GND lines and a DE/RE jumper.

servo-driver-16.brief: A 16-channel servo driver: a PCA9685 with sixteen 3-pin servo headers along the board edge and a power screw terminal.

speaker-crossover.brief: A passive two-way speaker crossover: an air-core inductor, film capacitors, and binding-post terminals, no active parts.

stepper-a4988.brief: A stepper motor controller using an A4988 driver, microstep-select DIP switches, a motor connector, and a 12 V screw terminal.

stm32-min.brief: A minimal STM32F103 development board (LQFP-48) with USB-C, an 8 MHz crystal, an SWD header, and boot/reset buttons.

thermocouple-amp.brief: A K-type thermocouple amplifier board (MAX31855) with a screw-terminal input and an SPI header output.

usb-a-power-splitter.brief: A USB-C input to dual USB-A host-power splitter with per-port current limiting and status LEDs.

usb-c-full-breakout.brief: A USB-C receptacle breakout exposing VBUS, GND, the CC and SBU pins, and the high-speed pairs to 0.1-inch headers.

usb-pd-trigger.brief: A USB-C PD trigger board that outputs a switch-selectable 9 V, 12 V, or 20 V.
